clips.name: glitch
clips.alt: The dancer turning, original left and with Glitch right: in short bursts rows of the picture tear sideways with red, green and blue fringes and square blocks jump, with clean frames in between
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Intensity 0.75, Density 0.45 – bursts with clean frames between.

clips.name: crt-screen
clips.alt: CRT Screen on the dancing figure. Left: the whole frame, bulging, with rounded corners and a faint darker band rolling down. Right: part of the dancer enlarged three times, drawn in horizontal lines with fine red, green and blue stripes
clips.caption: CRT Screen, Flicker 0.8. Left: the whole frame. Right: enlarged 3× pixel for pixel.

clips.name: film-prism
clips.alt: Film Prism on the dancing figure. Left: the whole frame with coloured edges. Right: the middle of the stage, where she dances, enlarged twice: the white dress gains a red edge on one side and a blue-green edge on the other, and fine grain moves over the picture
clips.caption: Fringe 1, Prism shape, Grain 0.4. Left: the whole frame. Right: the middle of the stage enlarged 2× pixel for pixel; the grain moves.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab
clips.alt: The dancer, original left and through Analog Signal Lab's Worn VHS preset right: softer, warm cream colours, noise speckles crawling through the dark background
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: the Worn VHS preset.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-presets
clips.alt: The dancing figure on the whole stage four times in a grid, moving in sync, each with one preset: Snowy Reception top left with coloured grain and a faint ghost to the right of her, Worn VHS top right softer and warmer with a torn, noisy strip along the bottom edge, Tube Television bottom left on a curved screen with dark rounded corners and fine lines, Rolling Picture bottom right in heavy snow, torn sideways and slipping up and down
clips.caption: The four presets on the moving dancer, in sync.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-signal-strength
clips.alt: The dancer close up while Signal Strength runs from 1 down to 0.1 and back: the clean picture fills with grain and snow, colour fades and the picture starts to tear and roll at the weakest values; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Signal Strength from 1 down to 0.1 and back.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-ghost-level
clips.alt: The dancer close up while Ghost Level runs from 0 to 0.8 and back: a second, fainter copy of her appears a little to the right and grows stronger; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Ghost Level from 0 to 0.8 and back, Ghost Delay 1.8 µs.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-sync-instability
clips.alt: The dancer close up while Sync Instability runs from 0 to 1 and back: the lines start to wobble sideways and at high values the picture tears and jumps; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Sync Instability from 0 to 1 and back.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-luma-bandwidth
clips.alt: The dancer close up while Luma Bandwidth runs from 0 to 1 and back: at 0 the picture is smeared sideways, at 1 her outline and the folds of the dress are crisp; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Luma Bandwidth from 0 to 1 and back.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-tracking
clips.alt: The dancer close up on tape (VHS Stage 1, RF / Antenna Stage 0) while Tracking Error runs from 0 to 1 and back: a band of noise and torn lines rises through the picture and grows; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Tracking Error from 0 to 1 and back, with VHS Stage 1 and RF / Antenna Stage 0.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-tape-wear
clips.alt: The dancer close up on tape (VHS Stage 1, RF / Antenna Stage 0) while Tape Wear runs from 0 to 1 and back: the picture gets softer, colours wash out and white dropout streaks flicker across it; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Tape Wear from 0 to 1 and back, with VHS Stage 1 and RF / Antenna Stage 0.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab-curvature
clips.alt: The whole stage on a tube (CRT Stage 1) while Curvature runs from 0 to 1 and back: the flat picture bulges into a rounded screen with dark corners; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Curvature from 0 to 1 and back, with CRT Stage 1.

clips.name: add-glitch
clips.alt: Screen recording: the pointer clicks + Add Effect in Properties, Effects, types glitch and clicks the Glitch tile; the Glitch card appears, the pointer drags its Density slider to 1 and the preview of the dancer breaks up
clips.caption: Adding Glitch: + Add Effect, type glitch, click the tile, drag Density.

clips.name: block-cloud-presets
clips.alt: The dancing figure on the stage six times in a grid, moving in sync, each covered by drifting clouds of square blocks in three sizes: Brand Base with calm clouds in pink, cyan, green, white, dark grey and blush whose edges scatter into single blocks; Nervous with fast twitching edges and blocks that keep changing colour; Breathing with slow clouds that grow and shrink; Hesitant with dense clouds that hold; Clear with large solid patches of only pink, cyan and green; Wave with dense clouds that a ragged diagonal front will sweep away
clips.caption: The six presets on the moving dancer, in sync, at Progress 0.7.
